India Tests Hydrogen Train and Rocket Engine

India has conducted trial runs for its first hydrogen train and successfully tested a next-generation rocket engine for ISRO. The hydrogen train, capable of covering approximately 250 km on a single refuelling, underwent a trial run between Delhi and Jind. Meanwhile, ISRO's successful test of a semi-cryogenic engine is expected to accelerate preparations for the Gaganyaan mission.
